title: Mequon-Thiensville school district launches long-range facilities planning process
text:
Schools
Mequon-Thiensville school district launches long-range facilities planning process
The Mequon-Thiensville School District has begun a long-range facilities master planning process, according to the district.
The Mequon-Thiensville School District announced it has launched a long-range facilities master planning process, according to a district newsletter posted Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026.
The planning effort covers four areas, the district said. One focus is instructional spaces and capacity, which will assess how classrooms and shared spaces support modern teaching practices and evaluate building capacity and section needs, including spatial capacity at Oriole Lane, using updated demographic data.
A second focus is capital maintenance, with the district developing a predictable 10-year maintenance plan to maintain building mechanical systems such as HVAC, electrical and plumbing, along with structural envelopes and safety infrastructure, the district said.
The process also includes fiscal sustainability planning, modeling adaptable financial scenarios intended to ensure operational stability across school environments, according to the district. The fourth area integrates high school athletic facility planning into the district's broader districtwide facility schedule.
The newsletter also included results from the district's September 2026 family survey. The Mequon-Thiensville School District reported an overall Net Promoter Score of 55, matching last year's rating, with elementary families accounting for 60% of all responses. The district said 86% of new families enrolled because of the district's academic reputation, 93% of respondents reported their children feel safe at school, 88% felt well-prepared and welcomed before the first day, and 85% of families transitioning to new buildings said orientation eased the move.
The newsletter did not specify a timeline for completion of the facilities planning process or detail how community members can participate.
Source: Lake Shore Middle School, https://lake-shore.mtsd.k12.wi.us/index.php?pageID=smartSiteFeed&psqFeed=true&articleID=94611391
